scope: full77 controlled warm-per-sample inactive allocator cap study

protocol.treatment: synchronize,set cap,clear,one full-cohort warm,reset active peak,untimed diagnostics,one timed full-cohort sample
protocol.order: alternate each paired repeat; reverse initial order for second cap so default/capped arm positions balance across10pairs

limits: One fixed batch shape with per-sample cache clearing does not establish long-lived variable-shape allocator behavior.
The original cap is restored; no production setting changes.
Peak is active allocation only; active+cache is separately retained.
Cumulative process counters/global swap do not establish a cause.
Same77 training-source examples; released-model exposure unknown.
Source snapshots attest setup-time disk bytes, not already-imported code or external dependency execution.
